account-inactivity-notice.title: Your account will be deleted unless you sign in
account-inactivity-notice.preview: Your inactive account is scheduled for deletion
account-inactivity-notice.heading: We are about to delete your account
account-inactivity-notice.instructions: You have not used your {appName} account for {months} months and there is nothing running on it, so we are scheduling it for deletion on {date}.
account-inactivity-notice.stop: Signing in is all it takes to keep it. Nothing else is needed.
account-inactivity-notice.cta: Sign in and keep my account
account-inactivity-notice.download: If you would rather have a copy of your data first, you can download it from your account before that date.

account-inactivity-reminder.title: Last reminder: your account will be deleted on {date}
account-inactivity-reminder.preview: Last reminder before your account is deleted
account-inactivity-reminder.heading: Last reminder
account-inactivity-reminder.instructions: Your {appName} account will be permanently deleted on {date}. This is the last email you will get about it.
account-inactivity-reminder.stop: Signing in keeps your account. Nothing else is needed.
account-inactivity-reminder.cta: Sign in and keep my account

account-deletion-requested.title: Confirm you want to delete your account
account-deletion-requested.heading: Confirm you want to delete your account
account-deletion-requested.instructions: You asked to delete your {appName} account. Nothing has happened yet - use the button below to confirm.
account-deletion-requested.consequences: Once confirmed, you have {days} days to change your mind. After that your account and every server on it are permanently deleted.
account-deletion-requested.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email and change your password. Nothing will be deleted.

account-deletion-scheduled.title: Your account will be deleted on {date}
account-deletion-scheduled.preview: Your account is scheduled for deletion
account-deletion-scheduled.heading: Your account is scheduled for deletion
account-deletion-scheduled.instructions: Your {appName} account and every server on it will be permanently deleted on {date}.
account-deletion-scheduled.stop: Changed your mind? You can stop this at any time until then.
account-deletion-scheduled.download: If you want a copy of your data, download it before that date - afterwards it is gone.

account-deletion-cancelled.title: Your account will not be deleted
account-deletion-cancelled.heading: Your account will not be deleted
account-deletion-cancelled.instructions: The deletion of your {appName} account has been cancelled. Nothing was removed and everything works as before.
account-deletion-cancelled.hint: If it was not you who cancelled it, change your password and contact support.

account-deleted.title: Your account has been deleted
account-deleted.preview: Your Virtbase account has been deleted
account-deleted.heading: Your account has been deleted
account-deleted.userRequest: Your account and all servers on it have been permanently deleted, as you asked. There is nothing left to restore.
account-deleted.inactivity: Your account had been inactive for a long time, so it and all servers on it have been permanently deleted. There is nothing left to restore.
account-deleted.retained: We are required to keep your invoices and the accounting records behind them for {years} years under German tax law. They hold no more of your data than the law requires, and they are deleted once that period ends.
account-deleted.farewell: Thank you for having been a customer.

confirm-identity.title: Your {appName} security code
confirm-identity.heading: Confirm it's really you
confirm-identity.instructions: Enter this code to confirm a sensitive change to your {appName} account:
confirm-identity.hint: This code expires in 10 minutes. If you didn't ask for it, ignore this email – nothing will change.

data-export-ready.title: Your data export is ready
data-export-ready.preview: Your data export is ready to download
data-export-ready.heading: Your data export is ready
data-export-ready.instructions: Everything {appName} holds about you is ready to download ({size}). The file is a PDF: it can be read as a document, and it carries your full records as JSON plus a copy of every invoice attached inside it.
data-export-ready.passphrase: You will need the passphrase shown when you asked for this export. We do not send it by email, and we cannot recover it - if you no longer have it, simply request a new export.
data-export-ready.expiry: This download expires in {days} days, after which the file is deleted.

abuse-case-notice.title: Abuse report about your service ({reference})
abuse-case-notice.body:
We have received an abuse report about your service.

Case {reference}, reported as {category}. Please open the case, check the affected server and reply within {deadlineHours} hours. If we do not hear from you, we may have to restrict the service to stop the abuse.

abuse-case-resolved.title: Abuse case {reference} is closed
abuse-case-resolved.body: The abuse case {reference} has been closed. No further action is needed from you. If you have questions about it, reply to the case and we will pick it up.

abuse-case-restricted.title: Your service has been restricted ({reference})
abuse-case-restricted.body_throttle: Because of the open abuse case {reference}, the network speed of the affected server has been limited. You can still log in and fix the problem. Reply to the case once you have, and we will lift the limit.
abuse-case-restricted.body_isolate: Because of the open abuse case {reference}, outbound network traffic from the affected server has been blocked. Your data is untouched and you can still reach the server through the console. Reply to the case once the problem is fixed, and we will lift the block.
abuse-case-restricted.body_power_off: Because of the open abuse case {reference}, the affected server has been shut down. Your data is untouched. Reply to the case and we will start it again as soon as the problem is settled.
abuse-case-restricted.body_terminate: Because of the open abuse case {reference}, the affected server has been scheduled for termination. Reply to the case immediately if you believe this is a mistake.

payment-decline-reason.expiredCard: The card we have on file has expired.
payment-decline-reason.insufficientFunds: There were not enough funds available to cover the payment.
payment-decline-reason.cardDetails: The card details we have on file were not accepted.
payment-decline-reason.noPaymentMethod: There is no payment method saved on your account for us to charge.
payment-decline-reason.cardUnusable: The payment method we have on file can no longer be used.
payment-decline-reason.authenticationExpired: The payment had to be confirmed with your bank, and the confirmation window closed before that happened.
payment-decline-reason.temporary: The payment could not be processed. Problems like this usually clear on their own.
payment-decline-reason.declinedByBank: Your bank declined the payment. They do not tell us why, so they are the ones who can say.
payment-decline-reason.unknown: The payment did not go through, and we were not told why. In most cases this is a temporary hold rather than anything wrong with your account.

renewal-payment-failed.title: We couldn't take payment for your server
renewal-payment-failed.heading: We couldn't take payment for your server
renewal-payment-failed.description: We tried to charge {amount} to renew {serverName}, and the payment did not go through.
renewal-payment-failed.card: We used the card ending in {last4} ({brand}).
renewal-payment-failed.nextAttempt: We will try again on {date}. If you update your payment method before then, we will use the new one.
renewal-payment-failed.reassurance: {serverName} is still running and nothing has been deleted. There is time to sort this out.

renewal-final-warning.title: Your server will be suspended on {date}
renewal-final-warning.preview: {serverName} will be suspended unless the payment goes through
renewal-final-warning.heading: Your server is about to be suspended
renewal-final-warning.description: We still have not been able to collect {amount} to renew {serverName}.
renewal-final-warning.card: We used the card ending in {last4} ({brand}).
renewal-final-warning.lastAttempt: We will make one final attempt on {date}.
renewal-final-warning.noFurtherAttempt: We will not try this payment method again. Your bank has told us it cannot be charged, so nothing further will happen until you add another one.
renewal-final-warning.deadline: If the payment is not settled, {serverName} will be suspended and switched off on {date}.
renewal-final-warning.retention: Your data is kept for {days} days after that. If the payment is still outstanding then, the server and everything on it is deleted permanently and cannot be recovered.

payment-method-invalid.title: Your payment method needs replacing
payment-method-invalid.preview: Your saved payment method can no longer be used
payment-method-invalid.heading: Your payment method needs replacing
payment-method-invalid.descriptionCard: The card ending in {last4} ({brand}) saved on your account can no longer be used for payments.
payment-method-invalid.description: The payment method saved on your account can no longer be used for payments.
payment-method-invalid.hint: Adding a replacement takes a minute and keeps your servers renewing without interruption. Until then, every renewal that falls due will fail.
